COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRJANo.24 of 2022
Shri Sanjaya Kumar Mishra, ACJ.
Shri Ramesh Chandra Khulbe,J. 
Shri J.S. Virk, learned Deputy Advocate 
General and Shri Rakesh Kumar Joshi, learned 
Brief Holder for the State are present.
This is a jail appeal.
We have perused the record. The office has 
reported that there is no delay in filing of this 
appeal. Hence, the appeal is admitted. 
Ms. Deepa Arya, Advocate, is appointed as 
Amicus Curiae to argue the case on behalf of the 
appellant. 
Call for the scanned copies (both hard and 
soft copy) of the trial court record. After 
receiving the trial court record, the Registry shall 
prepare the paper book and supply the same to 
learned Amicus Curiae and learned Deputy 
Advocate General, as per Rules. 
Matter be listed for final hearing, as and 
when directed. 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.) (S.K. Mishra, ACJ.)
 10.05.2022
